'''John G. Fleagle''' is an American [[anthropologist]], [[primatologist]], and Distinguished Professor at [[State University of New York, Stony Brook]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.anat.stonybrook.edu/IDPAS/index.php?page=faculty/fleagle |title= Welcome IDPAS|website=www.anat.stonybrook.edu |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100611184042/http://www.anat.stonybrook.edu/IDPAS/index.php?page=faculty%2Ffleagle |archive-date=2010-06-11}}</ref>

==Education==
He graduated from [[Yale University]] ''cum laude'' in 1971, and from [[Harvard University]] with a M.S. in Anthropology in 1973, and from [[Harvard University]], with a Ph.D. in Biological Anthropology in 1976.

==Awards==
* 2023 Charles Darwin Lifetime Achievement Award<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.stonybrook.edu/newsroom/press-release/awards/professor-john-fleagle-to-receive-charles-darwin-lifetime-achievement-award/|title=Professor John Fleagle to Receive Charles Darwin Lifetime Achievement Award - SBU News|date=2023-01-10|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref>
* 1988 [[MacArthur Fellows Program]]
* 1982 [[Guggenheim Fellowship]]

==Works==
A selection of Fleagle's works is listed below.
* {{citation |author=Fleagle J.G, Simons E.L |title=The humerus of ''Aegyptopithecus zeuxis'': a primitive anthropoid |journal=[[American Journal of Physical Anthropology]] |volume=59 |issue=2 |pages=175–93 |date=October 1982 |pmid=6816072 |doi=10.1002/ajpa.1330590207 }}
* ''Anthropoid origins'', Editors John G. Fleagle, Richard F. Kay, Plenum Press, 1994, {{ISBN|978-0-306-44791-4}}
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=dcD5HgBMgA0C&dq=inauthor%3AJohn%20inauthor%3AG%20inauthor%3AFleagle&pg=PP1 ''Primate communities''], Editors John G. Fleagle, Charles Helmar Janson, [[Kaye Reed|Kaye E. Reed]], Cambridge University Press, 1999, {{ISBN|978-0-521-62967-6}}
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=PgiGPYeVN0sC&pg=PR3 ''Primate adaptation and evolution''], Academic Press, 2nd edition 1999, {{ISBN|9780122603419}}; 3rd edition 2013 {{ISBN|978-0-12-378632-6}}
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=K2J_8vSsbFwC&pg=PA375 ''Primate biogeography: progress and prospects''], editors Shawn M. Lehman, John G. Fleagle, Springer, 2006, {{ISBN|978-0-387-29871-9}}
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=2j7unoyZN-oC&dq=inauthor%3AJohn%20inauthor%3AG%20inauthor%3AFleagle&pg=PP1 ''Elwyn Simons: a search for origins''], Editors John G. Fleagle, Christopher C. Gilbert, Springer, 2007, {{ISBN|978-0-387-73895-6}}
